questions.question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.**

My visiting to my family are few and far between.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is **'My visiting to'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** 

 
• In the given part, we need to use **'visits' **instead of** 'visiting'.**
 
• As the sentence talks about **many visits** so we need a plural subject and a plural verb (are).
 
• The verb used is already in plural form so we need to change the subject in its plural form.
 
• We already have a noun for visiting i.e. **visits**, so we will replace 'my visiting' with 'my visits'.
 
• The meaning of the phrase few and far between is-** scarce; infrequent.**

The correct sentence will be- *"**My visits to my family** are few and far between."*
